description: A painted scene in dark, warm tones. In the foreground a woman with an updo and a grey trench coat drops a folded paper into a wooden ballot box. Behind her a line of women in headscarves and coats waits, and one woman in a full black chador with a face veil holds a paper. At a table on the right, officials with a ledger sit under a hanging lamp, and a man in a suit writes. No visible text, no frame, and the painting fills the canvas edge to edge.
